scenes.title: Apply the record workflow to your department

captions.text: This workflow can document a security supervisor handover, a
search-and-rescue coordination exercise, a community paramedicine
or mental health team handover, wildland contractor coordination,
industrial response exercises, or fire and E M S department work.
The form fields and responsibilities should match your department.
The repeatable pattern is to choose the correct form, review the
working draft, verify revisions and confirm the final numbered record.
